description: Apple announced that starting this month, iCloud+ subscribers in India and other select markets will get access to Apple TV and Apple Arcade with their iCloud+ subscription at no additional cost. The expanded subscription lets users back up, store, and share personal content across all their Apple devices using iCloud, alongside accessing content from Apple TV and games in Apple Arcade. In India, iCloud+ plans start at Rs 75 per month for 50GB of storage.
title: Apple iCloud+ Plans in India Now Include Apple TV and Arcade at No Extra Cost

description: Delta Exchange has partnered with the India-Afghanistan T20I series as a global sponsor, giving the crypto exchange advertising visibility across the matches. The association includes on-ground and broadcast branding, along with fan engagement activities. The deal comes as crypto firms continue to explore consumer-facing partnerships despite restrictions on cryptocurrency companies sponsoring the Indian cricket team.
title: Delta Exchange Lands Global Sponsor Slot for India-Afghanistan T20I Series

description: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max will use MediaTek’s Dimensity 9600 Pro, based on TSMC’s 2nm N2P process. The chipset brings a new CPU configuration, G2-Ultra NX graphics and dual NPUs for on-device AI tasks. Oppo has also developed its Laminar Flow Engine with MediaTek for the phone. The Pro Max will launch in China later this month with three 200-megapixel rear cameras, Hasselblad-developed camera hardware and an 8,000mAh battery. Oppo has not yet announced its international release schedule or pricing.
title: Oppo Find X10 Pro Max to Be Among First Phones With MediaTek's 2nm Dimensity 9600 Pro Chip

description: Vivo Buds Clip will launch in China alongside the Vivo X500 series and Vivo Watch 6 on September 21. It is teased to come in Floating Purple, Moonlight White and Starry Night Black (translated from Chinese) colourways. The upcoming earphones are currently available for pre-order in China. Vivo is also gearing up to announce OriginOS 7 at the Vivo Developer Conference 2026 on September 16.
title: Vivo Buds Clip Launch Date Confirmed for September 21, Colour Options Revealed

description: A Gnosis Safe wallet on Ethereum lost around 2,900 rsETH tokens worth approximately $7.8 million (roughly Rs. 74.7 crore) after an attacker exploited a faulty authorisation mechanism in a helper contract. Security firms said the issue was linked to a component trusted by the wallet rather than Safe’s core contracts. A trading bot known as Yoink later front-ran the exploit and captured most of the stolen tokens.
title: Ethereum Wallet Exploit Drains $7.8 Million in rsETH Tokens, Security Firms Warn

description: Googlebooks will enter the pre-order phase later this month, giving the new laptop category its first confirmed sales window. Google has yet to reveal pricing or the models that will initially reach customers. The company has also detailed several features planned for the laptops, including Gemini Intelligence, Magic Pointer and Create My Widget. Android integration will allow users to access phone apps and files from their laptops. Googlebooks will use the Android technology stack and feature the returning Glowbar above the keyboard.
title: Googlebook Laptops to Open for Pre-Orders on September 21, Google Confirms

description: The Samsung Galaxy A18 4G could arrive in France with a lower price than previously expected, according to a new leak. The reported French configuration includes 128GB of storage, while Samsung may offer more storage in other markets. The handset could also bring an Exynos 1610 chipset instead of the previously rumoured MediaTek processor. Other reported features include a 90Hz Super AMOLED display, triple rear cameras, a 5,000mAh battery and Android 17. Samsung has not confirmed these details yet.
title: Samsung Galaxy A18 Price and Specifications Reportedly Leaked Again Ahead of Expected Launch

description: LG, in a recent statement, has addressed the privacy and security concerns regarding its smart TVs. The company said that LG smart TVs do not “continuously record or transmit” user conversations. Further, the tech giant said that the speech-to-text processing starts only after a user initiates voice interaction via the “supported wake-word feature” or by pressing the voice or AI button on the smart TV remotes. LG claims that the audio used for wake-word detection is locally processed on the smart TV. Hence, if the device does not detect the wake word, the audio is not converted into text and is neither stored nor transmitted by the smart TV.
title: LG Denies Its Smart TVs Secretly Record Conversations, Explains How Voice Features Work

description: MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro mobile platform has been launched globally. The octa-core chipset is built on a 2nm process. Moreover, it features a 2 + 3 + 3 AI Compute Fusion CPU architecture, with two prime cores, three performance cores, and three efficiency cores. It also gets the new L2 + L3 cache architecture, along with support for LPDDR6 RAM and UFS 5 storage. The SoC features the 1090 NPU with dedicated Performance and Flexible cores. Moreover, the MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset features the new Mali G2 Ultra NX GPU, with a system cache of 10MB. Its AI Imaging Fusion Architecture gets Semantic Analysis Engine, TrueColor Engine, and FastFocus Engine.
title: MediaTek Dimensity 9600 Pro Built on a 2nm Process Launched With Support for LPDDR6 RAM and UFS 5 Storage

description: The government has clarified the rules around charges on digital payments. In recent days, there have been concerns over whether recent changes to the Payment and Settlement Systems Act, 2007, could eventually result in charges for UPI users in India. The latest notification, issued by the Ministry of Finance on Monday, reveals that consumers will not be charged for using UPI, while any future merchant discount rate (MDR) would apply only to select transactions.
title: Using UPI for More Than Rs 2,000? Here’s What It Means for Your Wallet

description: Vivo V80 India launch teased. It is confirmed to come with a Zeiss-branded rear camera unit. Previous leaks claimed that the Vivo V80 will go official in India in the first week of October. It is rumoured to feature a 50-megapixel telephoto camera with support for 3X zoom. It could feature a 7,200mAh battery. It is said to ship wth Android 17-based OriginOS 7 on top.
title: Vivo V80 India Launch Officially Teased, Key Details Revealed: What You Need to Know

description: Vivo V80, S2 FE and X500 Pro Max have surfaced in recent regulatory listings in India and Thailand. The V80 appeared on both BIS and Thailand's NBTC database, while the S2 FE was linked to BIS through model number V2640. The X500 Pro Max appeared on NBTC with model number V2610. Earlier reports have tipped specifications and launch details for the three phones, including 90W charging for the V80 and a Dimensity 9600 Pro chipset for the X500 Pro Max.
title: Vivo V80, S2 FE Reportedly Get BIS Certification Hinting at Imminent India Launch; X500 Pro Max Appears on NBTC

description: Apple refreshed its silicon lineup with the introduction of the M6 chip in August. At the time, the Cupertino-based tech giant also updated the Mac mini with the latest SoC. Now, an early benchmark listing has offered a glimpse at its performance. The Mac mini M6 is listed with 32GB of memory and a 12-core CPU. The listing also reveals its core configuration, which is headlined by two Super cores. The results reportedly suggest a notable multi-core improvement over the outgoing M5.
title: Mac Mini M6 Geekbench Listing Reportedly Reveals Performance Gains Over M5 Chip

description: iQOO 16 will be launched in China on September 29, the company announced on Tuesday. The launch event is scheduled to commence at 7:00 pm local time (4:30 pm IST). Separately, the company also revealed that the iQOO 16 will be available for purchase in the country in three colour options, namely “Chasing Light”, “Legendary”, and “Racing Track” (translated from Chinese). The Chasing Light colourway will feature a laser holographic back with hues of red and blue shades over a silver background. Meanwhile, the Legendary option uses the “magnetron sputtering electroplating technology” and 670nm thick electroplating film on the back over a shade of white. Lastly, the Racing Track colourway, the tech firm says, has been inspired by the purple paint of F1 cars.
title: iQOO 16 Launch Date Announced as Firm Reveals Colour Options, Design

description: CoinEx has announced a phased shutdown of its centralised exchange after nearly nine years of operation. New registrations will end on September 15, followed by the closure of derivatives services on September 22 and spot trading on September 29. Withdrawals will remain available until December 22. The exchange cited prolonged market weakness, reduced liquidity, and rising compliance costs.
title: CoinEx Set to Close Exchange After Almost Nine Years in Operation

description: OnePlus N6 Lite will be launched in India on September 22, the company announced on Tuesday via a press release. The company has also revealed that the smartphone will be equipped with a 7,000mAh battery. Moreover, it will feature a flat display that refreshes at up to 120Hz. The OnePlus N6 Lite will be available for purchase in the country via Amazon. It will be offered in two colour options, namely Midnight Hype and Neo Green.
title: OnePlus N6 Lite India Launch Date Announced; Key Specifications, Features Revealed

description: BGMI is gearing up to roll out its 4.6 Update tomorrow, which will bring a fresh batch of content and experiences to the popular battle royale game. Ahead of the update, Krafton India has released yet another set of BGMI redeem codes. This means players get one more chance to claim limited-time in-game rewards. The latest drop includes 50 codes linked to the new Dr. Quirk Set. But as always, players will need to act quickly since each code can be redeemed by a maximum of 10 users on a first-come, first-served basis.
title: BGMI Redeem Codes for September 15: Get Dr. Quirk Set and Other Free Rewards This Way

description: Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition will launch in India on September 21 at 12pm IST. A dedicated microsite for the handset is now live on the company and Flipkart websites. The upcoming phone features a brown leather finish and has an argyle-textured rear panel. Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter edition will be available with a Hogwarts-themed limited-edition gifting box. Only 5,000 units of the gifting box will be available for purchase.
title: Realme 16 Pro Harry Potter Edition India Launch Set for September 21; Key Specifications, Design Teased

description: Bitcoin is holding near Rs. 73.4 lakh as traders weigh weaker institutional demand against optimism surrounding the CLARITY Act vote. ETF outflows and uncertainty around the Federal Reserve and Bank of Japan are keeping volatility elevated, while Bitcoin’s resilience during the AI-stock selloff offers some support.
title: Bitcoin Holds Near $77,000 as CLARITY Act Vote Takes Centre Stage

description: Apple’s latest trade-in figures reveal a notable difference in how the iPhone Air is valued across the US and India. In the US, the Air and the cheaper iPhone 17 currently qualify for the same maximum trade-in credit, while the Pro models command higher values. The Air launched between the standard and Pro models in Apple’s pricing structure, making its current valuation particularly notable. In India, however, Apple assigns the Air a higher maximum trade-in value than the standard iPhone 17.
title: iPhone Air Trade-In Value Matches Cheaper iPhone 17 in US, Despite Higher Launch Price

description: Google’s Motion Assist feature is now expanding to additional Android smartphones. The feature displays bubbles around the edges of the screen that respond to the movement of a vehicle. It is designed to reduce motion sickness. The feature helps bridge the gap between what your eyes see and the movement of your ride. Set it to turn on automatically, add it to Quick Settings, and customise the bubble’s shape, colour, and opacity to match your style.
title: Google’s Motion Assist Expands to More Android Phones: How to Enable the Motion Sickness Feature

description: Redmi Note 17 Pro and Redmi Note 17 Pro Max were launched in India on Tuesday as the latest additions to the Xiaomi sub-brand's Note 17 lineup. The Redmi Note 17 Pro Max is powered by an octa-core Snapdragon 6 Gen 5 chipset. On the other hand, the Redmi Note 17 Pro features a Snapdragon 6s Gen 4 SoC. The Pro Max model is equipped with a 10,000mAh battery, while the Pro model packs a 9,000mAh cell. Both phones feature a dual rear camera unit. Moreover, the two phones will go on sale in India via Amazon.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max, Note 17 Pro Launched in India With Up to 10,000mAh Battery, 50-Megapixel Camera: Price, Features

description: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra and Galaxy S27 Pro reportedly come with the company’s next-generation M16 OLED display technology. The display may not offer 10,000 nits of peak brightness or a 165Hz refresh rate; instead, Samsung is said to integrate hardware-level privacy display features.
title: Samsung Galaxy S27 Ultra Tipped to Feature M16 OLED Panels; May Prioritise Privacy Over Brightness

description: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 series will be launched globally by the South Korean tech giant on October 7, according to a tipster. The Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Ultra has previously been spotted on the Geekbench benchmarking platform with the model number SM-X940. The listing suggested that the flagship tablet will be equipped with an octa-core MediaTek Dimensity 9500 chipset, which is built on a 3nm process, delivering a peak clock speed of 4.21GHz. It might ship with Android 17 and 12GB of RAM.
title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12 Series Will Reportedly Launch Early Next Month: Expected Specifications

description: Oracle is said to be carrying out another round of job cuts as the cloud company continues to invest heavily in artificial intelligence (AI) infrastructure. According to a report, the recent layoffs follow a broader reduction in the company’s workforce during its 2026 fiscal year. On one hand, the Oracle has committed to investing billions of dollars, with a fiscal 2027 capital expenditure forecast of up to $95 billion. Meanwhile, it reportedly communicated to affected employees this week, with severance packages offered to reduce costs.
title: Oracle Layoffs Reportedly Begin as Company Ramps Up AI Infrastructure Investments

description: Apple launched the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max at its ‘Surprise and shine’ event last week. Following the keynote, both handsets became available for pre-order, with availability in stores officially declared to begin on September 18. However, customers who have yet to place their orders for either of the handsets may now have to wait beyond the launch date in multiple countries, as Apple's online store is showing delivery estimates extending into October.
title: iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max Delivery Dates Slip to October in India, US After Preorders Begin

description: Anthropic has detailed several cases in which users turned to Claude for cyber espionage and military-related work. The company says one Russia-linked group used the model during an operation targeting organisations in Ukraine and Europe, while a China-linked group used it for intrusions, vulnerability research and intelligence gathering. Anthropic also identified six weapons-related cases spanning China, Russia and Yemen, covering software for missiles, drones, electronic warfare and an anti-torpedo system, along with procurement and intelligence activity across separate investigations reported.
title: Anthropic Says Claude Assisted Cyberattacks and Military Weapons Development

description: Oppo is gearing up to launch its next-generation F35 series in India soon. The company recently began teasing its upcoming lineup, which is expected to comprise the F35 and F35 Pro, even though its monikers officially remain under wraps. A new report now offers an early look at the design and colour options of both the purported handsets. The Oppo F35 series could be offered in six colourways in total, with different design treatments across the lineup.
title: Oppo F35, Oppo F35 Pro Design, Colour Options Reportedly Leak Ahead of India Launch

description: Redmi Note 17 Pro and Redmi Note 17 Pro Max are launching today in India. Xiaomi's sub-brand has scheduled a dedicated livestream to unveil the two smartphones in India. It is worth noting that the Redmi Note 17 Pro and Redmi Note 17 Pro Max’s launch livestream will commence at 12 pm IST, and you will be able to watch it via Redmi India’s official YouTube channel for all the details. Details regarding the India pricing and storage configurations of the Redmi Note 17 Pro and Redmi Note 17 Pro Max remain under wraps and are expected to be revealed during the livestream later today.
title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Drops in India Today: How to Watch the Launch Live
